description: Resource-type detection edge cases: plain file (not a collection), collection resolved under a server URL prefix, resourcetype element missing, path not found, and malformed XML.

input.multistatus_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<d:multistatus xmlns:d="DAV:">
    <d:response>
        <d:href>/data.json</d:href>
        <d:propstat>
            <d:status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</d:status>
            <d:prop>
                <d:resourcetype/>
                <d:getlastmodified>Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:00 GMT</d:getlastmodified>
                <d:getetag>etag-abc-123</d:getetag>
                <d:getcontenttype>application/json</d:getcontenttype>
                <d:getcontentlength>1024</d:getcontentlength>
                <d:displayname>data.json</d:displayname>
                <d:creationdate>2024-01-01T00:00:00Z</d:creationdate>
            </d:prop>
        </d:propstat>
    </d:response>
</d:multistatus>
